# lmnr_project (Data Source)

Reads the Laminar project that the provider's project API key belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The project that owns the configured project API key.
data "lmnr_project" "current" {}

output "project_id" {
  value = data.lmnr_project.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project UUID.
